theorem block_R3 {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {R D : ℝ} (hR0 : 0 < R) (j : ℕ) (hyD : R + j * q < D) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊R + j * q⌋ ⌊min (R + (j + 1) * q) D⌋, Tn α x n ≤
      3 * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)) / 2 * x * (1 / (R + j * q)) +
        2 * q * √(c₀ * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D))) / π * √(1 + q / (R + j * q)) :=

note: The book weights each block by its lower end log(jq+R), which does not bound log m on the block; Lean uses the upper end, so the j=0 term is (x/R)log(R+q) (≤ (x/R)log 3R for R ≥ q/2). Typo: After (4.61) the book cites the assumption x >= e^2 c/2 (the lemma states x >= e^2 c_2/2 = 2.481); (4.61) needs sqrt(c_2 x/2) >= e, i.e. x >= 2e^2/c_2 = 22.008 (at x = 10, q = 6 the left side 3.662 exceeds the right side 3.305), but U,V >= 1, Q_0 >= 2 sqrt x and UV + (19/18)Q_0 <= x/5.6 force x >= 150.757, so the slip is harmless. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_4_61.py`).
